thread:
maya: FYI onboarding blocked: sampleapp not sending invite emails when using Node SDK createTeam. Can someone take a look?

raj: Confirmed. Direct REST POST /v1/admin/teams with body {\"name\":\"acme\",\"invite_users\":true} creates invites. SDK call `client.admin.createTeam({name: 'acme', inviteUsers: true})` returns 200 but no invites.

sam: Any proxy or token scope issues?

maya: Token has admin:teams. Captured outgoing payload from SDK shows `{\"name\":\"acme\"}` — `inviteUsers` missing. Looks like serializer dropped the camelCase field.

laura: This smells like generator change in v1.4.x. Admin namespace mapping might have been excluded.

raj: Minimal repro Node:
```js
await client.admin.createTeam({name: 'acme', inviteUsers: true});
```
Working curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/teams \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"name\":\"acme\",\"invite_users\":true}'
```

maya: REST expects snake_case `invite_users`. SDK used to map camelCase->snake_case but generator missed admin endpoints.

sam: I'll patch the SDK serializer to perform camelCase -> snake_case for admin routes and add unit tests.

laura: Workaround: sampleapp will call the admin REST endpoint directly for createTeam until SDK fix lands. Unblock e2e.

raj: Also spotted retry mismatch: SDK currently retries on 409; REST treats 4xx as non-retriable. That causes duplicate attempts and noisy logs. We should not retry 4xx by default (keep 429 retriable).

sam: Agree. Update runtime retry classifier: mark 4xx as permanent except 429. Add per-endpoint override for unusual cases.

maya: Server can use Retry-After for transient 409s; we'll default to REST semantics.

laura: Filed tracker: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-DX-521 to track serializer + retry parity + sampleapp hotfix.

sam: I'll open two PRs: generator serializer fix and runtime retry change with tests.

maya: I'll push sampleapp hotfix (call REST if SDK createTeam seems to not create invites) and revert after patch lands.

ci-bot: CI: PR #3621 started  unit tests queued.

raj: Thanks, please drop other admin parity issues here.

maya: Pairing with sam in 30 to review generator change. :thumbsup:
